body:
Well where do I even start to begin???? My closest friends and I wen't through the transition of smoking blunt's one fine day to shooting dope the next. Meth if you really wanna know can ruin your life and your 'friends' all in one day. Stop reading if you want but I am about to tell you some of the realest shit you have ever heard in your life. Man, meth literally ruined my life!!! Guess where all my best friends are? Either in jail or DEAD!!! Is the high really worth it? Well I will tell you from first hand experience that it is not. I am truly the only person that I have ever met that shot dope and quit. When I start seeing my peeps selling their souls for that shit and literally turning into demons and I mean real live one on one DEMONS, that's when one needs to check their shit and possibly evaluate their situation and their 'so called' life. I have watched my friends go from some of the smartest mother fuckers you will ever meet to str8 J's. I mean we all had it going for us. I could have been whatever I wanted to be in life, but instead I am sitting here facing a DUI, and 3 felony's. And you know what is so fucked up, I am one of the lucky ones.
